title: Lore.Land Canon
logline: The canon records itself. A small reader can check the whole history. The last door is shell-shaped.
epigraph: Canon is a promise to remain inspectable.
description: Chapter 13 of Lore.Land: Lore.Land Canon. The serial closes its first loop by making the world’s self-record a public, revisitable surface. The egg rests on a small desk. The last door is an eggshell leaking gold light. The cell keeps its own law, and the door stays open.

content.text: The archive at the end of the seam was smaller than its reputation. Boof paused where the path thinned into shelves. Behind her: furrow, grove, sand, keys, rift, glass, oath, well, shards, spine, bloom, confluence. She set the egg on a small reading desk — a desk that could check a whole history without re-running it — and saw, at the far wall, a

children.text: : the last door was shell-shaped, cracked, leaking gold. Canon here meant a durable return path, not a sealed dogma. The cell on the desk kept its own law. The door stayed open.

content.text: The vault did not hide. It showed its load path. Every receipt from the serial could be folded into a history a small reader could verify from a single root. Boof did not need to be a clerk. She needed the door to remain a door.
"This is where it all leads, Boof," the Fool’s voice was soft. "You’ve seen me in every step. Now see the cell. It was never mine to name."

img.alt: An open night archive, a cracked-eggshell door leaking gold light, the coal-dark egg on a small reading desk.

sections.figcaption: Canon: inspectable record, shell-shaped door, cell still itself.

content.text: Boof looked from the desk to the door. The first dawn and the last shelf agreed on one thing: the egg had arrived on a road that did not exist yet, and the record had learned, chamber by chamber, how to receipt a cell without owning it. Four laws, load-bearing, unornamented: cell, key, turn, receipt. She left the egg on the desk. A small reader could check the whole history. The next cycle could re-enter without pretending the first never happened.

content.text: "I see now," Boof whispered. She had not been chasing the Fool. She had been following a true scent to a door the canon was willing to leave open. Behind her the serial remained walkable. Ahead, through the shell, something inside the cell kept time. She did not name it. Naming would wait for a turn the world was ready to admit.

A small reader at a single desk can check a whole history. The last door is shell-shaped on purpose.
The egg remains a cell: it keeps its own law. The record learns to receipt it without owning it.
The open door is intentional: the next cycle can re-enter without pretending the first never happened.
